verification_policy: Single-skill Other Super research: independently reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition, stamina behavior, and counter taxonomy. Preserve unresolved numeric/version-sensitive values as null.
research_scope: Phantom Fist — Other Super / defensive movement-counter taxonomy / PQ97 acquisition.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository research coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Dragon Ball/Xenoverse 2 references.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Phantom Fist was found. The canonical identity is Super / Other.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Phantom Fist as an Other Super. It is also treated as a universal counter within the repository's broader Counter Skills taxonomy because it can evade incoming attacks of different types.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Phantom Fist is obtained by the Future Warrior from Parallel Quest 97 — Insidious Plot. Independent documentation confirms the PQ97 route.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the reviewed sources establish PQ97 acquisition but do not establish an Ultimate Finish requirement for this skill.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100. Stamina recovery is a core mechanic, but an exact canonical stamina amount is not promoted because sources and versions differ.

records.name: Phantom Fist
records.character_source: Mira / Hit / Yamcha (Supervillain) / Masked Saiyan / Frost / Fu customizable partner / Future Warrior
records.skill_description: A defensive movement Super that creates an afterimage-like stance; when an attack connects, the user vanishes and reappears while recovering stamina.
records.mechanics_notes: Phantom Fist functions similarly to Afterimage but consumes Ki in Xenoverse 2 and restores stamina when the evasion triggers. Historical reports describe version-specific activation and repeated-use behavior, so exact frame windows and stamina values are not encoded as canonical numbers.
records.acquisition_notes: The documented Xenoverse 2 Future Warrior route is Parallel Quest 97 — Insidious Plot. It is also used by Mira, Hit, Yamcha (Supervillain), Masked Saiyan and Frost, with later customizable-partner availability.
records.pve_notes: PQ97 acquisition; exact drop probability and Ultimate Finish dependency remain unresolved.
records.pvp_notes: Defensive evasion/counter-style behavior can avoid incoming attacks and restore stamina. Historical player reports document balance changes, so exact timing and repeated activation behavior should be treated as version-sensitive.
